bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for community solutions for healthy child development grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY SOLUTIONS FOR HEALTHY CHILD DEVELOPMENT GRANTS. +]

[+$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution for community solutions for healthy child development grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 145.9285. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for community solutions for healthy child development grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY SOLUTIONS FOR HEALTHY CHILD DEVELOPMENT GRANTS.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution for community solutions for healthy child development grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 145.9285.
additions: APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY SOLUTIONS FOR HEALTHY CHILD DEVELOPMENT GRANTS.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for distribution for community solutions for healthy child development grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 145.9285.
